description: Emission-size budgets (MT7). 0% slack: any probe that emits MORE than a recorded threshold fails test-lambda-baseline. Landing intended growth means reviewing the emission diff and lifting the number here in the SAME commit, so the growth is visible in review (D8.6.1). A probe that emits LESS passes and prints the tightened values; committing them is the manual re-baseline. This file is never written by the test. Profiles are looked up as <platform>-<config>, then <platform>, then default -- a platform that legitimately emits differently (Windows commits side-stack pages in the prologue) gets its own explicit entry rather than silent slack. Instruction counts come from the finalized MIR artifact; frame shape comes from LAMBDA_MIR_LOG_FRAME_SLOTS telemetry, whose function names are a separate namespace (LambdaJS reports several emitted functions under one debug name), which is why 'functions' and 'frames' are addressed separately. Re-baseline 2026-09-22: Lambda cells include the reviewed native stack guard needed to report recoverable stack exhaustion (S7.11.1v2); the snapshot is an exact ratchet, not causal tuning attribution.

probes.name: lambda_corpus_array_float
probes.description: Picked corpus script (array-heavy), whole-module total only. v5 re-baseline: int array elements use the i64 lane and box only at an Item boundary; two uext8 instructions normalize C bool results used by is-null checks. Growth 2026-09-13 (+3): the const-fold pass now declines when `context->heap` is absent. The eager pipeline compiles before runner_setup_context()/heap_init(), so folding there evaluated with no GC heap and faulted in heap_calloc on an allocating fold (`type(42)`); RC14 requires a fold attempt to be inert, so the pass stands down and these three folded constants are emitted as ordinary computations. Restoring them means giving the compile pipeline an allocation-capable context, not re-enabling the unguarded pass. Re-baseline 2026-09-13 (+10 net, Tune27 T27-7/T27-9): float literals evaluate every member first, then allocate once and store directly into the packed buffer, removing all 47 `array_float_set` calls (and the post-call typed-array layout reload each one carried) for a few more plain instructions; the fused band branches recover part of that. Growth 2026-09-14 (+8, Tune27 §10.11): a non-proven typed index read now tests that its receiver Item is a container pointer before the header probes; a read through a null or out-of-bounds record yields a null T[] link (S7.1.3v2), which the old guard dereferenced at address 0 (typed_path_store SIGSEGV on the JIT tier). Four such reads here, two instructions each. Re-baseline 2026-09-17 (Tune28 T28-7 emission diet: literal returns keep the native lane, proven indices into fixed-length locals, raw int equality against an in-band operand, one-call cold boxing, jump-to-next-label removal).
